# TebScribe

> TebScribe LLC is a New York limited liability company founded by Dr. Mohammad Chelehmalzadeh, a practicing emergency medicine physician. Built by an ER doctor, it makes tebIQ (an ambient AI medical scribe for ER doctors, hospitalists and clinics), tebDictate (a free medical dictation app), tebChart (a discharge instructions app for iPhone), a free IMG roadmap for foreign medical graduates, free medical calculators, and more. The clinician reviews and signs every note. Encrypted in transit and at rest (AES). Never used for training. Never sold.

## tebIQ — AI medical scribe

tebIQ is an AI medical scribe, also called an ambient scribe or AI scribe for doctors, for clinicians. It listens to the patient encounter and drafts the clinical documentation: a SOAP note, or history, medical decision making, assessment and plan for emergency medicine, shaped for the specialty. It also supports nurse notes. It runs in a web browser, on iPhone, on Apple Watch and on Android. The clinician reviews and signs every note; tebIQ does not diagnose or treat.

- Website: https://tebiq.com
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6756632709
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tebscribe.tebiq
- Pricing: https://tebiq.com/pricing
- Security: https://tebiq.com/security
- [tebRounds](https://tebscribe.com/apps/tebrounds.html): the hospitalist view of tebIQ, with a rounding board, discharge gating and a discharge summary drafted for a physician to review and sign (in pilot).

## tebDictate — free medical dictation app

tebDictate is a free medical dictation app and dictation app. Open tebdictate.com on any computer, scan the QR code with your phone, and use voice to text (speech to text) to dictate to any computer; your phone is the wireless microphone. It works for nurse dictation and doctor dictation, needs no account and nothing to install, and the connection is end-to-end encrypted. Speech is recognized on your phone.

- Website: https://tebdictate.com
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790673075
- [How free dictation works](https://tebscribe.com/free-dictation/)

## tebChart — discharge instructions app

tebChart is a discharge instructions app and medication list app for iPhone, a hospital discharge app for patients and their caregiver. Scan your discharge papers and it organizes the after visit summary, your medications, follow-up visits and the questions worth asking. Records are stored privately on your iPhone, with no health records on TebScribe servers.

- Website: https://tebchart.com
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782081865

## For international medical graduates

- [IMG roadmap](https://tebscribe.com/IMG/): a free 10-part guide from foreign medical graduate to U.S. residency: ECFMG certification, USMLE, OET, U.S. clinical experience, ERAS and the Match, what to do if you do not match, practicing without repeating residency, visas and a master checklist. Requirements change; confirm with ECFMG, NRMP and USCIS.

## Free tools

- [Free medical tools](https://tebscribe.com/free-medical-tools/): clinical score calculators (HEART, Wells, CURB-65, NEWS2), tebCalc for ChatGPT and Claude (coming soon), free dictation and free educational GPTs.
- [Free medical dictation](https://tebscribe.com/free-dictation/): your phone is the microphone; the words appear on any computer. Free.

## Other products

- [tebIntake](https://tebscribe.com/apps/tebintake.html): an offline, multilingual patient-intake kiosk for front desks; not yet released.
- [tebCapture](https://tebscribe.com/apps/tebcapture.html): your phone is an encrypted camera; send video to your computer. Web tool live, iPhone app in testing.
- [Bellody](https://tebscribe.com/bellody/): a private family organizer for iPhone (schedule, school, chores, co-parenting, caregiver info). No account, no ads, no tracking.
